title: Time for p
description: Essential: The final numerical answer for part (1) is 1 s.

title: Acceleration on incline
description: Important: Correctly applies Newton's second law or kinematics to find the acceleration of ball p as g sin θ.

title: Kinematics for p
description: Important: Uses the correct kinematic equation (s = 1/2 a t²) to relate the length l, acceleration, and time for ball p.

title: Initial speed for q
description: Essential: The final numerical answer for part (2) is 2.165 m/s (or equivalent 5√3/4 m/s).

title: Simultaneity condition
description: Important: Recognizes that the time of flight for ball q equals the slide time t1 for ball p.

title: Horizontal displacement
description: Important: Correctly identifies the horizontal displacement of ball q as l cos θ.

title: Projectile kinematics
description: Optional: Applies the correct horizontal motion equation (x = v0 t) for ball q's uniform motion.

title: Sign or unit error
description: Pitfall: Makes a sign error in the incline acceleration or misuses cos/sin for the horizontal displacement.

title: Incorrect time equation
description: Pitfall: Uses an incorrect kinematic equation (e.g., l = v t) for the accelerated motion of ball p.
